thread:
claire: heads-up: planning a controlled enable for `sharded_routing_v2` tonight. want to validate dry-run & approval steps first.
deploy-bot: reminder: deployment window request pending for 23:00-00:30 PT
juan: quick question: do we require one or two approvers from platform for config flips? past incidents suggest two.
ingrid: +1 on two. suggest `require_two_approvals=true` on PRs that touch runtime routing.
marta: i can wire console to show the approval state and block toggle if approvals < required. UI label: "activation_blocked: approvals_needed".
claire: good. also introduce `dry_run_mode=v2` on /api/configs/preview that returns both current and candidate route per request so we can compute mismatch ratio offline.
theo: telemetry changes: add `candidate_route`, `stable_route`, `config_rev`, and `mismatch_reason` as trace attributes. set trace_sample_rate=0.5% for full payloads and 100% for shallow counters.
sam: rollout gates: start 2% for 15m, check p50/p95 token latency, error_rate, and mismatch_ratio. abort if mismatch_ratio > 1% or error_rate delta > 0.3%.
juan: where do we surface mismatch_ratio? dashboard + alert. marta can you add a small "Route Diffs" chart and a one-click query to list sample requests?
marta: yes. will add chart to Config > routing_v2 and a button "export diff sample" that pulls 200 traces. default access restricted to authors+platform approvers.
claire: for runbook, single rollback line please:
```
# rollback to last stable rev
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  https://console.internal/api/configs/rollback \ 
  -d '{"config_name":"sharded_routing_v2","to_rev":"rev-2026-03-19-2230"}'
```
sam: adding to runbook. also adding a quick sanity-check script to compute mismatch_ratio in the last 5m. i'll run every 5m during window.
ingrid: policy: PR must include `rollout_window` label + `activation_playbook.md` link. approvals must be by author peer + one platform approver. platform approver should ack in PR comment with `/approve-platform`.
juan: can console API enforce approvals before toggling? i.e. return 403 if approvals < required?
marta: yes, backend will check PR status via git metadata and enforce. will surface reason in UI tooltip.
claire: final checklist: 1) marta: preview + UI approval blocking + route diff chart, 2) theo: trace attributes & sampling, 3) sam: runbook + sanity script, 4) ingrid: approve PR before 21:45 PT.
deploy-bot: deployment window confirmed 23:00-00:30 PT (auto-approved).
claire: thanks. if nobody objects, i'll flip the PR to "ready for platform" at 20:30 PT and tag ingrid + theo. keep comments short if you need changes. :thumbsup:
